title: Base change of integrated section specialization for arbitrary finite coefficients
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, N a positive integer with N A = 0, and S and Sprime noetherian schemes on which N is invertible [lem-trf-finite-ring-section-deformation]. Let g:V to S and gprime:Vprime to Sprime be compactifiable smooth separated quasi-compact morphisms of pure relative dimension d, with closed sections s and sprime and supplied Geometry witnesses [lem-trf-finite-ring-section-deformation]. Let b:Sprime to S and q:Vprime to V form a Cartesian square preserving the sections [def-pc-base-change]. Supply the canonical cone-to-bundle Cartesian squares, and Rees family isomorphisms kappa and kappaprime normalized at one [def-pur-finite-smooth-canonical-maps]. Define integratedSpecialization(g,s,kappa) as zero specialization followed by inverse normalSectionMap and the inverse integration adjunct on the conormal bundle [def-pur-vector-purity-normalization]. Then pullback of integratedSpecialization followed by the specified Kummer-normalized Tate-line comparison equals the canonical sectionMap followed by integratedSpecialization(gprime,sprime,kappaprime). This statement concerns section invariants only; no diagonal factor or orientation of a smooth morphism is assumed or concluded. It includes d=0, empty schemes and the zero coefficient ring.

proof.text: For the Cartesian change of smooth section pairs, identify the new pair with the canonical pullback pair. Extended-Rees base change identifies the family and both fibres, preserves the sections, and identifies the associated-graded map with the symmetric conormal base-change map. This identifies the actual normal cone with the pulled-back normal bundle, preserving its projection and zero section.

proof.text: Transport the normalized Rees comparison through the family exchange. The exceptional-fibre coherence equation at one shows that this transport is normalized. Uniqueness of the finite-ring normalized comparison identifies it with the supplied primed comparison. Restriction at zero gives sectionMap followed by specialization-prime equal to pullback(specialization) followed by normal-section exchange.

proof.text: The Kummer-normalized vector integration trace commutes with arbitrary Noetherian base change. Transpose this equality through the actual compact-support adjunctions and restrict to zero. Invertibility of the integration adjunct gives its inverse orientation square. Homogeneous normalization of the cone-to-bundle isomorphism identifies its section comparison with the normal exchange in the preceding step.

proof.text: Compose the specialization square and the inverse-integration square, then cancel the intervening normal exchange. This is the displayed integratedSpecialization square by its explicit three-factor definition. The tensor-root comparison is the specified purityTwistTransport. Rank zero uses empty tensor products, arbitrary coefficient rings need no scalar flatness, and empty schemes or zero rings give equations in zero categories.

lean.statement:
theorem integratedSpecialization_baseChange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    {V S V' S' : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian S']
    (d : ℕ) (g : V ⟶ S) (g' : V' ⟶ S')
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g']
    [IsSeparated g] [QuasiCompact g] [HasCompactification g]
    [IsSeparated g'] [QuasiCompact g'] [HasCompactification g']
    (s : S ⟶ V) (s' : S' ⟶ V') [IsClosedImmersion s] [IsClosedImmersion s']
    [FiniteRingSectionDeformation.Geometry d g s]
    [FiniteRingSectionDeformation.Geometry d g' s']
    (hs : s ≫ g = 𝟙 S) (hs' : s' ≫ g' = 𝟙 S')
    (b : S' ⟶ S) (q : V' ⟶ V) (cart : IsPullback q g' g b)
    (hsec : s' ≫ q = b ≫ s)
    (sq : IsPullback
      ((reesConeComparison s ≪≫ FiniteRingSectionDeformation.coneBundleIso d g s).hom)
      (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g s)
      (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d (ConormalGradedAlgebra.piece s 1)) (𝟙 S))
    (sq' : IsPullback
      ((reesConeComparison s' ≪≫ FiniteRingSectionDeformation.coneBundleIso d g' s').hom)
      (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g' s')
      (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S' d (ConormalGradedAlgebra.piece s' 1)) (𝟙 S'))
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (hS' : IsUnit (N : Γ(S', ⊤)))
    (κ : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.family A g s ≅
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S ↘ S)).obj
        (sectionInvariant A g s))
    (κ' : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.family A g' s' ≅
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S' ↘ S')).obj
        (sectionInvariant A g' s'))
    (hκ : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.Normalized A g s hs κ)
    (hκ' : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.Normalized A g' s' hs' κ') :
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A b).map
        (integratedSpecialization A d g s hs sq N hN hA hS κ) ≫
        (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA
          (WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.purityTwistTransport A N hN hA) b hS d).hom =
      NoetherianSectionSpecialization.sectionMap A g g' b q cart s s' hsec ≫
        integratedSpecialization A d g' s' hs' sq' N hN hA hS' κ'
